msg-noclay: Out of clay. Hold clay of the same type as the form to keep going.
msg-noserver: This server doesn't have Automatic Clay Former installed, so it can't take clay for automatic forming. Automatic forming is off on this server. (The WorkOnUnmoddedServers setting turns it on anyway, but then clay isn't taken.)
msg-unmodded-warning: Warning: this server doesn't have Automatic Clay Former, but WorkOnUnmoddedServers is on, so automatic forming works here without taking any clay. That may count as cheating on this server. To stop it, set WorkOnUnmoddedServers to false in ModConfig/AutomaticClayFormer.json (or /clayformer unmodded off in single player) and rejoin.
msg-unmodded-tool: On servers without the mod, automatic forming can't change your clay tool, and this shape can't be finished with the one selected. Select the single-voxel tool.
msg-stalled: The server isn't accepting changes to this clay form (out of reach, or no permission here?). Trying again in {0} seconds.
cmd-status: Automatic forming: {0}. Range: {1} blocks (your reach is {2}). Speed: {3} clicks per second. Chat messages: {4}. On servers without the mod: {5}. Type /clayformer help for the commands.
cmd-help:
Automatic Clay Former: place clay, pick a recipe, and hold clay of the same type near the form. It shapes itself, using clay like forming by hand.
/clayformer: show your settings
/clayformer on or /clayformer off: turn automatic forming on or off
/clayformer range 1-16: how far away forms get shaped, in blocks (only up to your reach)
/clayformer speed 1-100: how fast it works, in clicks per second (default 20)
/clayformer messages: switch chat messages when forming starts and finishes on or off (or add on or off)
/clayformer unmodded: also work on servers without the mod (off by default; clay isn't taken there, so it may count as cheating)
/clayformer server on or off (server admins): allow or stop automatic forming for everyone on this server
/clayformer help: this list
cmd-notinstalled: Your game doesn't have Automatic Clay Former 2.1.0 or newer, so there are no settings to change. Each player's settings are kept in their own game, so install it there (the server has it).
cmd-playeronly: Only players can use this: the settings are kept in each player's own game.
cmd-needs22: That needs Automatic Clay Former 2.2.0 or newer in your game.
cmd-unmodded-on: Automatic forming will also work on servers that don't have the mod. Clay isn't taken there, so it's free, and the server may count it as cheating: check its rules.
cmd-unmodded-off: Automatic forming is off on servers that don't have the mod.
cmd-server-on: Automatic clay forming is allowed again on this server.
cmd-server-off: Automatic clay forming is now off for everyone on this server. (Players on versions before 2.3.0 don't know this switch; it's kept in ModConfig/AutomaticClayFormerServer.json.)
cmd-on-serveroff: This server has automatic forming turned off, though, so it stays off here.
msg-server-off: This server has automatic clay forming turned off.
msg-server-on: This server has turned automatic clay forming back on.
cmd-range: Range set to {0} blocks. Your reach is {1} blocks, so forming happens up to whichever is smaller.
cmd-speed: Speed set to {0} clicks per second.
cmd-messages-off: Chat messages turned off. Problems like running out of clay are still shown.
